tracks.label: Matching decompiled C code
tracks.scope: USA ROM SHA-1 7195ea96d9fe5de065af61f70d55c92c8ee905e6. Conventional matching-decompilation project: after one-time extraction, the build compiles, assembles, links and re-encodes without reading the base ROM, then reproduces its SHA-1. Original assembly and the single inline-assembly allocator workaround are source-complete but excluded from ordinary-C credit.
